react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-analysis paradigms converge on a single dominant biological signal: dysregulation of C21-steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned FDR = 5.8×10⁻¹⁸ (fold enrichment 1501×) for the Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism cluster (SMPDB:SMP00068 / KEGG:map00150), hitting six input steroids (DHEA, androstenedione, testosterone, DHT, estrone, estradiol) against a 27-metabolite pathway background. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently confirmed KEGG:hsa00140 with raw p = 5.77×10⁻⁷, covering the same six steroids. Mummichog m/z-direct activity analysis placed 'Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism' (MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) as the top hit (p = 8.4×10⁻⁵, 14 of 14 pathway metabolites matched), with the related C21-steroid pathway as rank 1. Caffeine (KEGG:hsa00232, p = 0.049) was a marginal secondary hit. All six steroid compounds share structurally distinct InChIKey first-blocks (confirmed by reconcile_inchikey — no connectivity conflicts), ruling out any namespace artefact. The treatment group exhibits coordinated differential abundance across the entire steroidogenesis axis from DHEA through downstream androgens and estrogens, consistent with perturbation of CYP17A1, aromatase (CYP19A1), or 5α-reductase activities. The carbohydrate and amino-acid hits (sucrose, 4-hydroxyglutamic acid, inosine 2',3'-cyclic phosphate, N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl) did not reach significance in any paradigm.

MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently returned KEGG:hsa00140 (Steroid hormone biosynthesis) as rank 1 with p = 5.77e-7, hitting the identical 6 steroids against an 87-metabolite background. Caffeine was a marginal secondary hit returned by MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (KEGG:hsa00232, p = 0.049). final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-analysis paradigms converge on a single dominant biological signal: dysregulation of C21-steroid hormone biosynthesis and metabolism. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned FDR = 5.8×10⁻¹⁸ (fold enrichment 1501×) for the Androgen and Estrogen Metabolism cluster (SMPDB:SMP00068 / KEGG:map00150), hitting six input steroids (DHEA, androstenedione, testosterone, DHT, estrone, estradiol) against a 27-metabolite pathway background. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA independently confirmed KEGG:hsa00140 with raw p = 5.77×10⁻⁷, covering the same six steroids. Mummichog m/z-direct activity analysis placed 'Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism' (MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism) as the top hit (p = 8.4×10⁻⁵, 14 of 14 pathway metabolites matched), with the related C21-steroid pathway as rank 1. Caffeine (KEGG:hsa00232, p = 0.049) was a marginal secondary hit. All six steroid compounds share structurally distinct InChIKey first-blocks (confirmed by reconcile_inchikey — no connectivity conflicts), ruling out any namespace artefact. The treatment group exhibits coordinated differential abundance across the entire steroidogenesis axis from DHEA through downstream androgens and estrogens, consistent with perturbation of CYP17A1, aromatase (CYP19A1), or 5α-reductase activities. The carbohydrate and amino-acid hits (sucrose, 4-hydroxyglutamic acid, inosine 2',3'-cyclic phosphate, N-hydroxy-4-aminobiphenyl) did not reach significance in any paradigm.
